text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Whoa!? Are these props for the play!? 
They're crafted with incredible detail!

text_block_list.name: Drama Club Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
Ehehe, I made it. Being good with my hands 
is pretty much my only redeeming quality.

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
Hmm... Ah... They even have mini beds like 
this.

text_block_list.name: Drama Club Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
Every single one is full of memories, but 
if we kept everything, the clubroom would 
overflow, so I was sorting out what to 
throw away.

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
It really is a massive amount... Oh, I 
know! If you'd like, I can help you clean 
up!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
"Taishin, I'll help clean up, so go on 
ahead!"

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: ...Well, I'll help out too.

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: Huh? Taishin too?

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
Mm... But in exchange, I have a favor to 
ask...

text_block_list.name: Drama Club Umamusume
text_block_list.text: Yes...?

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
All right, that's everything! All cleaned 
up~!

text_block_list.name: Drama Club Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
Thank you so much, that was a huge help! 
Taishin-san, here's what I promised...

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: ...Thank you.

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
That mini-bed you were looking at earlier? 
Taishin, were you promised you could have 
this?

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: Well... yeah.

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Eeeh?! Even for you, Taishin, isn't this 
way too small to sleep in? Your whole 
body's gonna ache!

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
As if I'd go to sleep, dummy! ...I'm 
leaving already.

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: Ah, wait for me, Taishin!!

One evening, as I was passing by the 
school gates, I spotted Winning Ticket 
looking all around restlessly.

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
"I thought I just saw Taishin a moment 
ago, but I lost sight of her. I wonder 
where she went..."

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: —Ah, found you! Heyyy!

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: ...I wonder if they're here.

text_block_list.name: Black Kitten
text_block_list.text: Fnyu...

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
Ah, there you are. Are you still sulking? 
Dummy... Here, a new bed.

text_block_list.name: Black Kitten
text_block_list.text: *sniff sniff*... *purr*.

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
What're you cozying up to me for, you 
opportunist... Well, at least this'll make 
up for that cushion, won't it?

Narita Taishin watches over the kitten 
relaxing in its mini-bed with a 
surprisingly gentle gaze.

Just as I was about to tell Winning Ticket 
that we should head back to the academy—

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: UWOOOOOOONNN!! I'm zo moved~~~!!!!

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: Huh!? Why are you... !?

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Taishin, you worked so hard helping the 
drama club just to get a present for the 
kitten~! You're zo kind-hearteddd~~~~!!

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
Ugh, shut up! Peeping is totally uncool, 
get out of here--!!

text_block_list.name: Black Kitten
text_block_list.text: Mnyaaah!!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Ah, kitty, don't go! Come here, I'm not 
scary--!

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
It's running away because you're too loud! 
Keep it down... or better yet, go away!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Ah, sorry, kitty cat! I'll be quiet, 
please forgive me!

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: Shut uuup!

From a little distance away, the kitten 
watched the two making a fuss. Its 
expression seemed exasperated, yet somehow 
looked like it was smiling... or so it 
seemed.

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
Huh!? Since when were you guys standing 
there...!?

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
*hic*, *sob*! *snort*, *sniff*, I'm, I'b 
zo bouveddd~~...!

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
Shh... Don't talk so loud...! You'll 
startle the cats...!

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
"This cat... was rescued through the local 
community cat program hosted by the shrine 
here."

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
That favorite cushion of hers was 
completely worn out, you see. She lost her 
cozy spot to relax, and looked pretty down 
about it, so...

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
"Ugh... Waaaahhhhhh!! Such, such an 
emotional, touching story~~!!"

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
I've gotta share this touching story with 
everyone! I'm gonna go pass it down across 
the whole academy~!

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
Hah!? W-Wait, stop it, Ticket! Hold on... 
I said stop!!

Narita Taishin and the others scramble 
away. The kitten left behind curls up on 
the bed, looking completely content.
